title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, events)
summary: Internal Operations table with one row per calendar day recording whether the Valdena shop was open (is_open) and an optional local event name (event_name). Catalog metadata gives daily grain, coverage from 2022-01-01 with no end date, and a weekly refresh, but the stated row count (~1,500) is smaller than the ~1,744 calendar days from 2022-01-01 to the last refresh on 2026-10-10, so full daily coverage is not confirmed. The data was not sampled because no sampling route was available to this profiler.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Local event that day, if any

schema.notes: Field names and types come from the catalog entry only; no wiki page or schema document was found. Source of event_name values and the rule for is_open on closed days are not documented.

spatial.notes: Single shop location in northern Italy (client context from use case spec). No location or region column in the table, so the shop identity is implicit to the table. Place codes: none. Join to holidays or weather would be by date only.

access.request_process: Open to analytics roles (catalog access.request_process). Not tested; access role of the requester not verified.

quality_notes: Row count vs coverage: catalog says ~1,500 rows at daily grain from 2022-01-01 with no end date. From 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-10 there are about 1,744 calendar days, so ~1,500 rows implies roughly 240 days missing, or the row count is stale. Not verified; catalog row count was not checked against the table.

Window coverage not verified: the history window (2023-06-01 to 2025-05-31, 730 days) and recent window (2025-06-01 to 2026-03-31, 304 days) both fall inside the stated coverage, but completeness of days inside them is unknown.
No wiki page links to this entry (wiki_backlinks = 0). No documented rule for how is_open is set on closed days, holidays or days with no record, and no source for event_name.
Owner and steward are given in the catalog only; no wiki page confirms them.

Catalog and use case disagree on nothing directly, but the catalog's end date is null (open-ended) and the table was refreshed on 2026-10-10, which is after the UC2 recent window end (2026-03-31) and before its as_of date (2026-10-15).
